fato_historico: 1922: King Constantine I of Greece abdicates his throne in favor of his eldest son, George II.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a beautiful shifting of the tides within your soul. Much like a monarch stepping down to allow a fresh spirit to lead, it is a good time to consider releasing outdated habits. You might discover that by letting go of your old crown, you finally make space for the brilliance of your true self.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the grace of embracing your next great chapter.
significado_numero: The master builder number representing manifestation and lofty visionary goals.
conselho: Trust your intuition when it whispers that a change is truly necessary.
